isolation: HttpApi _ready reads configuration and logs only; it does not request network or instantiate HTTPRequest.

RemoteSync _ready connects signals and reads pending data only; starting lease id is0, credential empty, preventing heartbeat. Its original node is freed before fixture profile, save, answer, or progress actions.
QuestionProvider startup waits for encounter context. Its request_get resolves /root/HttpApi, replaced by PoolTransport before fixtures.

Final harness first frees original RemoteSync and HttpApi, adds in-memory PoolTransport and ResultCapture, then assigns unique-save GameState subclass. Every test request returns a dictionary with no sockets/HTTPRequest/URL or transport forwarding.
Fixture save path is unique user://saves/final_world_quest_<ticks>.json; save override writes only this path. load_save reads only that exact test path. No human save modification.

Actual RemoteSync observer is later instantiated only with _pending_file set to unique user://final_remote_quest_<ticks>.json before add_child/_ready. Its processing is disabled. All its requests resolve the same in-memory PoolTransport; no original HttpApi is restored.
New-game and load calls pass false for session reset. Test credentials are offline fixture-only values; no real account identity or server lease is loaded.
The harness rejects and frees any newly added HTTPRequest before the caller can issue request, and asserts zero HTTPRequest nodes before fixture gameplay.
production_qa_enabled true is retained byte-for-byte for human use. No product configuration is changed for tests.
civilian_isolation: tools/final_civilian_preservation_test.gd inherits gameplay_civilian_expansion_test.gd._run unchanged; that method first frees original RemoteSync,HttpApi,QuestionProvider before any profile/map fixture, with no await before freeing them.

It then sets GameState to preservation_regression_state.gd, whose save_game writes only a unique test-owned user://saves/gameplay_civilian_expansion_<ticks>.json. start_new_game(PROFILE,false) cannot emit session reset.
No HttpApi or RemoteSync replacement is ever installed by civilian tests. No direct socket/HTTP API exists in its test body. Its runtime-added HTTPRequest guard also fails closed.
The original pending sync file is only read by normal autoload ready; original RemoteSync is removed before any state event, with empty leaseid/credential preventing startup heartbeat.
Inherited tests only load three canonical maps, simulate input/physics, and write new QA JSON plus unique fixture save. The existing immutable map snapshot remains read-only.
ui_isolation: final_ui_preservation_test._run first frees all3 live transports without awaiting; uses unique test save subclass, local scene/input/layout checks, no network-capable transport restored; adds same HTTPRequest guard.
all_eight_vs_isolation: Launch only tools/final_vs_provider_test.tscn, an isolated fixture scene, never loading screen or Start.

Inherited Node ready calls overridden _run: first removes original RemoteSync and HttpApi before any begin_encounter. Fresh GameState student and parent IDs must be empty or test terminates. No profile is loaded or started.

PoolTransport.request_get returns only a locally constructed dictionary after process_frame. It has no URL, HTTPRequest, HTTPClient, socket, or forwarding call. Actual QuestionProvider resolves /root/HttpApi to this PoolTransport.
ResultCapture.record_question_attempt only appends a duplicated dictionary to a local array. Original QuizManager resolves /root/RemoteSync to this stub and cannot invoke the original RemoteSync.

No save_game/load_save/start_new_game/request_post call is present in this harness. GameState.begin_encounter records only in-memory context/signals; end_battle clears state. No actual QuestUI route is attached to these fixtures, so no quest advancement/save can follow.

All8 scene resources and their effect/health scripts perform only UI/animation/heart updates; their sole changed integration dependency QuizManager modifies in-memory counters and calls ResultCapture.

HTTP bootstrap behavior inspected separately: HttpApi ready config/log only; RemoteSync ready read/connect only with no lease; no startup gameplay. Additional node_added guard rejects any real HTTPRequest before it can call request.
Writes are new run-stamped QA screenshots and QA JSON only. production_qa_enabled remains true and byte-unchanged; no live transport exists during the test.
